vulnerable_code:
@router.websocket("/ws/v2/orders/execution-feed")
async def order_execution_stream(
    websocket: WebSocket,
    redis: Redis = Depends(get_redis_client)
):
    await websocket.accept()
    init_msg = await websocket.receive_json()
    trader_account_id = init_msg.get("trader_account_id")
    if not trader_account_id:
        await websocket.close(code=4000, reason="Missing trader_account_id")
        return

    pubsub = redis.pubsub()
    await pubsub.subscribe(f"pubsub:orders:{trader_account_id}")
    try:
        async for message in pubsub.listen():
            if message["type"] == "message":
                await websocket.send_text(message["data"])
    finally:
        await pubsub.unsubscribe()
        await websocket.close()
diagnosis: The WebSocket order execution feed subscribes to Redis pub/sub channel pubsub:orders:{trader_account_id} specified by the client in the initial frame. It performs no authentication or account ownership verification, allowing any remote client to intercept real-time trade executions, fill prices, and order quantities belonging to other brokerage traders.
corrected_code:
@router.websocket("/ws/v2/orders/execution-feed")
async def order_execution_stream(
    websocket: WebSocket,
    redis: Redis = Depends(get_redis_client),
    auth_service: AuthService = Depends(get_auth_service)
):
    await websocket.accept()
    init_msg = await websocket.receive_json()
    auth_token = init_msg.get("auth_token")
    user = await auth_service.authenticate_token(auth_token)
    if not user:
        await websocket.close(code=4003, reason="Unauthorized")
        return

    trader_account_id = init_msg.get("trader_account_id")
    if not trader_account_id or (trader_account_id != user.trading_account_id and not user.is_compliance_officer):
        await websocket.close(code=4003, reason="Forbidden: unauthorized trading account")
        return

    pubsub = redis.pubsub()
    await pubsub.subscribe(f"pubsub:orders:{trader_account_id}")
    try:
        async for message in pubsub.listen():
            if message["type"] == "message":
                await websocket.send_text(message["data"])
    finally:
        await pubsub.unsubscribe()
        await websocket.close()
